name: What should I look for when choosing a whole home remodeling contractor?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a whole home remodeling contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor, prioritize experience with similar whole home projects, proper licensing and insurance, and a strong portfolio of completed work. Check references from past clients and review online testimonials. Ensure clear communication, a transparent bidding process, and a detailed contract outlining scope, timeline, and payment schedules. A reputable contractor will also have a solid understanding of local building codes in areas like Burbank or Studio City.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for experience, licensing, insurance, strong references, clear communication, and a transparent contract when choosing a remodeling contractor.
